Greetings gate team,
Eventful finish at the desk, and desk cover came up

I wanted to send a quick note on how the Companion Animal Travel Desk is settling into the usual rhythm. The desk has stayed steady with a good mix of check-in questions, document checks, and a few last-minute clarifications from travelers who needed calm, plain answers. That warm, professional tone is still doing the heavy lifting, and it helps keep the handoffs smooth when the line gets busy.

The senior coordinator has continued to steer daily service calls, which has been useful when we need a quick judgment on pet placement, carrier details, or special handling notes. We also had a couple of travelers come through with simple but important concerns, and the desk handled them without fuss. Small details matter here, especially when we are making sure each animal and owner gets clear guidance and a reassuring response. Mia was mentioned in one case, and the traveler left looking much more settled.

Please keep passing along anything unusual right away, especially if a case seems likely to shift from routine to delicate. A fast heads-up lets us keep the service warm and the process clean. The desk is in good shape overall, and with steady support from the gate team, Aurelia Skyways can keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk moving in the right direction.
